channel.title: Comments on: The gifts of failure

item.title: By: Marva Wisdom
item.dc:creator: Marva Wisdom
item.content:encoded:
I appreciate the dichotomy in the list outlined. It is an example of the complexity and heaviness of getting to know me all over again. There is no time to rest in my knowing but to lay bare my being.

item.title: By: ionemariarojas
item.dc:creator: ionemariarojas
item.description: Hi there, thank you so much for sharing these. They echo many of my pondering and wonderings and is so helpful to have tangible questions to work with. I am interested in exploring other ways of knowing and how a process of asking might look when I move away from the frustratingly well trodden paths of analysis and 'thinking brain'. I have also been sharing these with other friends and practitioners and considering ways to work through these collectively or via creative exchanges. In doing so, I wonder how to credit or include or share with your work so there is a fairer exchange?
item.content:encoded:
Hi there, thank you so much for sharing these. They echo many of my pondering and wonderings and is so helpful to have tangible questions to work with. I am interested in exploring other ways of knowing and how a process of asking might look when I move away from the frustratingly well trodden paths of analysis and ‘thinking brain’. I have also been sharing these with other friends and practitioners and considering ways to work through these collectively or via creative exchanges. In doing so, I wonder how to credit or include or share with your work so there is a fairer exchange?
